title: Hypothesis Output Format (HOF) 1.0
description: The one shape every engine connector must emit, so that engines built on different architectures become mechanically comparable and scoreable against the pack's verified claim register. Mirrors the register's shape so scoring is a join, not an interpretation.

engine.description: connector name, e.g. baseline-claude, codex-solo, co-scientist

seed_id.description: which seed brief this run answered, e.g. Q5

backend.description: inference backend actually used, e.g. claude-subagent, codex-cli, openai:gpt-4o

config_hash.description: hash over prompt template + parameters, so a run is reproducible

corpus_calls.description: how many corpus_api queries the engine made

statement.description: the claim, stated so it could be false

scope.description: PICO-style scoping, so the null is a decision rule rather than a strawman

condition.description: intervention and instrument regime (and band, where it matters)

null_hypothesis.description: what a negative result looks like

causal_level.description: the level in the pack's causal hierarchy (pack.yaml prompts.causal_levels), from L1 mechanism to L6 out-of-sample prediction. Witness totals are only comparable within a level.

rationale.description: the reasoning decomposed into steps, so certification can judge each one. Mirrors theoria's proof object.

justification_type.description: citation steps must resolve to work_ids in the corpus; computation steps must be checkable; given steps restate the seed

work_ids.description: required and non-empty when justification_type is citation

cited_work_ids.description: every corpus work the hypothesis leans on; must exist in the corpus

proposed_experiment.description: the measurement that would settle it, concretely enough to cost

required_instrument.description: instrument class (and band, where it matters); experiment cards map it to the pack's measurement areas

engine_native_score.description: whatever the engine ranks by (Elo, reward, self-rating); not comparable across engines, recorded for the verifier benchmark

novelty_self_claim.description: what the engine thinks is new about it; never trusted, always scored
